verdict.rationale: Background automation is a fair question for a domain and commerce platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows no user-configurable automations, scheduled jobs, or autonomous background workflows. Auto-renew is a single built-in renewal flag, an adjacent control rather than a general automation capability. The CLI agent skill and MCP server run interactively inside a conversation, not autonomously in the background.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
